next_delta_read.zh: 将本组判断所需的实际区别与已完成目的形成、反馈取得和修订历史的输出逐项对应，说明形成的能力怎样取得理由并用于回应；复用机制，明示规范输入，继续检验道德及其他智慧范围。
next_delta_read.en: Match the distinctions needed by these judgments to outputs of completed goal formation, feedback acquisition and revision histories, explaining how formed capacities acquire reasons and use them in response. Reuse mechanisms, disclose normative inputs and continue testing moral and other wisdom scope.

next_delta.zh: 形式部分已在第一部分完成（wisdom-root-part-one）；留下：把这些规律与本组判断所需的区别对到人类发展与 AI 训练中实际形成的证据，说明形成的能力怎样取得理由并用于回应；关切与情感的形成（认知一章的义务）；这组关系对全部智慧的充分性；继续检验道德及其他智慧范围，明示规范输入（第二部分）。
next_delta.en: The formal part is completed in Part I (wisdom-root-part-one). What remains: matching these laws, and the distinctions these judgments need, to evidence of actual formation in human development and AI training, explaining how formed capacities acquire reasons and use them in response; the formation of concern and affect (the cognition chapter's obligations); the sufficiency of these relations for all wisdom; continued testing of moral and other wisdom scope with normative inputs disclosed (Part II).

next_delta_read.zh: 多步 Scope 的桥：感知只经识的策略在识得相同的流上有同样的所见范围；实验：变动自己的动作并识差别；模型从哪里来（P66 给出哪些投影承载模型：恰是投影相同的配置同去者，见 projection-carrying-a-law）；由动力学给出回应，而不是另给它（P65 另给其余经其识回应，并把比较定在回应所及之内）；识关于什么（校准）。
next_delta_read.en: The multi-step Scope bridge: a policy sensing only through registration has the same visible scope on flows registered alike; experiment: varying one's own act and registering the difference; where a model comes from (P66 states which projections carry one: exactly those under which configurations alike go alike, projection-carrying-a-law); responses given by the dynamics rather than supplied (P65 supplies that the rest responds through its registration and decides the comparison within the responsive reach); what a registration is about (calibration).

next_delta.en: The multi-step Scope bridge: a policy sensing only through registration has the same visible scope on flows registered alike; experiment: varying one's own act and registering the difference; where a model comes from (P66 states which projections carry one: exactly those under which configurations alike go alike, projection-carrying-a-law; P73 states when a model's generalization is right: exactly where the world goes alike across what it lumps, generalization-through-lumping); responses given by the dynamics rather than supplied (P65 supplies that the rest responds through its registration and decides the comparison within the responsive reach); what a registration is about (calibration); learning where registration does not tell values apart (below threshold).

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P73：相同者同去读作一个归并：确定律经 π 同去，恰当 π ∘ next 经 π 同去（goAlike_iff_lumped），依 Ren 的理把结构与变化认作一个；结果转移恰在步骤同去之处（transfer_right_iff）；外围的 Hebb 式发展与更新路线是 adaptive 的实例（generalization-through-lumping）；next_delta 随之修订；见整合文档 §{S_LEARNING}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P73: going alike read as a lumping: a determined law goes alike under π exactly where π ∘ next goes alike across π (goAlike_iff_lumped), structure and change being one under Ren's 理; an outcome transfers exactly where the step goes alike (transfer_right_iff); the periphery's Hebbian development and route of updating are instances of adaptive (generalization-through-lumping); next_delta revised; see §{S_LEARNING} of the integration note. The claim is unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P73：经识的选择是经“识得相同”的选择（Training.web_selectsThrough_iff）；训练作为经数据的选择是同一形式：损失经数据选择，在数据之外自由的类中使未试之值与类同样自由，拟合在数据之外正确恰当类在那里决定（generalization-through-lumping）；见整合文档 §{S_LEARNING}。断言与 next_delta 不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P73: selection through registration is selection through registering alike (Training.web_selectsThrough_iff); training as selection through the data has the same form: a loss selects through the data, leaves the untried value as free as a class free beyond the data, and a fit is right beyond the data exactly where the class determines it (generalization-through-lumping); see §{S_LEARNING} of the integration note. The claim and next_delta are unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P73：归纳的规律在第一部分陈述，不用公理：无记录固定下一个，每个学习者都有否证它每个主张的开放的序列，被列表所持的世界中按否证学习的否证有界、静止不能被否证（learning-by-refutation）；推广恰在世界经模型所归并者同去之处正确（generalization-through-lumping）；见整合文档 §{S_LEARNING}。它们是科学探究的必要关系的一部分，不证明完整核心对科学的不可或缺性；断言与 next_delta 不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P73: the laws of induction are stated in Part I with no axiom: no record fixes the next value, every learner has an open course refuting each of its claims, and in a world held by a list learning by refutation is refuted a bounded number of times with its rest unrefuted (learning-by-refutation); a generalization is right exactly where the world goes alike across what the model lumps (generalization-through-lumping); see §{S_LEARNING} of the integration note. They are part of the necessary relations of scientific inquiry and do not prove the whole core indispensable to science; the claim and next_delta are unchanged.
